title: Ascending Convex Polyominoes
summary: Convex polyominoes can be refined according to the number of direction changes in monotone paths connecting pairs of cells, leading to the notion of $k$-convexity. In particular, the cases $k=1$ and $k=2$ correspond to $L$-convex and $Z$-convex polyominoes, two well-studied subclasses of convex polyominoes, with intermediate families such as centered and $4$-stack polyominoes.
